newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Boehler 9-mo net profit down 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Boehler 9-mo net profit down 22 pct.

text.p: Austrian high-grade steelmaker Boehler-Uddeholm said on Tuesday net profit in the first nine months of the year fell 22 percent to 632 million schillings ($59.8 million) and that pretax profit fell eight percent.
Boehler said in a statement it still aimed to post a flat pretax profit for the full year. ($ = 10.57 Austrian Schillings)
Last year Boehler reported pretax earnings of 1.351 billion schillings.
In the first nine months, Boehler posted a pretax profit of 890 million schillings, down from 966 million. Sales hit 13.285 billion schillings, down from 13.848 billion.
Boehler attributed the 22 percent drop in net profit to a significantly higher tax rate of 29 percent from 16 percent in the year-ago period.
Incoming orders stood at 7.133 billion schillings as of September 30, down 25 percent from 9.533 billion. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
